item.title: Mexican Navy medical flight lost communication for several minutes before Texas crash
item.description: Courtesy: AP Air traffic controllers lost communication for about 10 minutes with a small Mexican Navy plane carrying a young medical patient and seven others before it crashed off the Texas coast, killing at least five people, Mexico’s president said Tuesday. item.title: City of Chattanooga Details Christmas Tree Disposal
item.description: MGN The City of Chattanooga reminds us that they have options on how to dispose of live Christmas trees after the season. Their tree recycling program begins on the day after Christmas. Locals can drop off trees at one of five recycle centers across the city. You can find the locations and hours of each on the city’s website at https://chattanooga.gov/services/waste-recycling....

item.title: Curbside Compost Pilot Expands
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF) – The City of Chattanooga is expanding its curbside compost and glass recycling pilot program to three additional neighborhoods. The Department of Public Works announced Monday the program will now include Missionary Ridge, Ridgedale, and Highland Park. item.title: FDA Approves First Obesity Pill
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF) – The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the first daily pill designed to treat obesity, marking a major milestone in weight loss care. The newly approved medication is an oral version of Wegovy, produced by Novo Nordisk.
